name: Resignation - Direct Manager Assignment
script:
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PF HR05 Resignation Request
# Controls:
# (A) Auto-fill direct_manager_user + Auto-Assign ToDo on Submitted
# (B) Only Direct Manager can move Submitted -> Manager Recommended
# (C) Create Employee Separation Case when state changes TO Accepted
# (D) Notice Period validation when moving TO Accepted
# Event: Validate
# ------------------------------------------------------------

previous = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_state = previous.workflow_state if previous else None
new_state = doc.workflow_state

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: get Direct Manager User (email) from Employee.reports_to.user_id
# ------------------------------------------------------------
report_user = None

if doc.employee:
    reports_to_emp = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.employee, "reports_to")
    if reports_to_emp:
        report_user = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", reports_to_emp, "user_id")

    # Keep direct_manager_user populated (if field exists)
    if not doc.direct_manager_user and report_user:
        doc.direct_manager_user = report_user

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (A) Auto-Assign ToDo when moving to Submitted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Submitted" and new_state == "Submitted":

    if not report_user:
        msg = _("Cannot submit the request because the direct manager is not set.")
        msg = msg + "\n" + _("Please check Reports To in Employee and ensure the manager has a User ID.")
        frappe.throw(msg)

    # Avoid duplicate assignment
    already_assigned = frappe.db.exists("ToDo", {
        "reference_type": doc.doctype,
        "reference_name": doc.name,
        "allocated_to": report_user,
        "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]
    })

    if not already_assigned:
        todo = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "ToDo",
            "allocated_to": report_user,
            "reference_type": doc.doctype,
            "reference_name": doc.name,
            "description": _("Resignation Request requires your recommendation."),
            "priority": "Medium",
            "status": "Open"
        })
        todo.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (B) Only Direct Manager can move Submitted -> Manager Recommended
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state == "Submitted" and new_state == "Manager Recommended":
    manager_user = doc.direct_manager_user or report_user

    if not manager_user:
        frappe.throw(_("Direct manager is not set in the request (direct_manager_user)."))

    if frappe.session.user != manager_user:
        msg = _("You cannot perform (Recommend Approval).")
        msg = msg + "\n" + _("This request is assigned to the direct manager only.")
        frappe.throw(msg)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (D) Notice Period validation ONLY when moving TO Accepted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Accepted" and new_state == "Accepted":

    if not doc.request_date or not doc.proposed_last_day or not doc.notice_period_days:
        frappe.throw(_("Please fill Request Date, Proposed Last Working Day, and Notice Period Days before accepting the resignation."))

    request_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.request_date)
    last_day = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.proposed_last_day)
    days_diff = (last_day - request_date).days

    if days_diff < int(doc.notice_period_days or 0):
        if not doc.get("notice_exception_attachment"):
            msg = _("Cannot accept the resignation because the notice period is not met.")
            msg = msg + "\n" + _("Required days:")
            msg = msg + " " + str(doc.notice_period_days or 0)
            msg = msg + "\n" + _("Actual days:")
            msg = msg + " " + str(days_diff)
            msg = msg + "\n" + _("Please attach an exception approval in Notice Period Exception Attachment.")
            frappe.throw(msg)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# (C) Create Employee Separation Case when moving TO Accepted
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if old_state != "Accepted" and new_state == "Accepted":

    if not doc.get("employee_separation_case"):

        existing_case = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Employee Separation Case",
            {"reference_no": doc.name},
            "name"
        )

        if existing_case:
            doc.employee_separation_case = existing_case
        else:
            case = frappe.new_doc("Employee Separation Case")

            case.employee = doc.employee
            case.case_type = "Resignation"
            case.reference_no = doc.name
            case.reference_date = doc.request_date
            case.effective_date = doc.proposed_last_working_day
            case.reason = doc.reason

            if case.meta.has_field("source_hr05"):
                case.source_hr05 = doc.name

            case.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

            doc.employee_separation_case = case.name

# ==================================
# CONFIG
# ==================================
DOCTYPE = "Visitors"     # 🔴 غيّرها إذا اسم Doctype مختلف
SYRIA_NAME = "Syria"    # أو "Syrian Arab Republic"

# ==================================
# Read params
# ==================================
from_date = frappe.form_dict.get("from_date")
to_date   = frappe.form_dict.get("to_date")

# ==================================
# Build filters (FIXED)
# ==================================
filters = {}

if from_date and to_date:
    filters["creation"] = [
        "between",
        [from_date + " 00:00:00", to_date + " 23:59:59"]
    ]
elif from_date:
    filters["creation"] = [">=", from_date + " 00:00:00"]
elif to_date:
    filters["creation"] = ["<=", to_date + " 23:59:59"]
# ==================================
records = frappe.get_all(
    DOCTYPE,
    filters=filters,
    fields=["gender", "nationality"]
)

# ==================================
# Counters
# ==================================
male = 0
female = 0
syria = 0
others = 0

# ==================================
# Process
# ==================================
for r in records:
    gender = (r.get("gender") or "").strip().lower()
    nationality = (r.get("nationality") or "").strip()

    # Gender
    if gender == "male":
        male = male + 1
    elif gender == "female":
        female = female + 1

    # Nationality
    if nationality:
        if nationality == SYRIA_NAME:
            syria = syria + 1
        else:
            others = others + 1

# ==================================
# Response
# ==================================
frappe.response["data"] = {
    "gender": {
        "male": male,
        "female": female
    },
    "nationality": {
        "syria": syria,
        "others": others
    },
    "total": len(records)
}

# moi_export_engine
import frappe
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import Workbook
from io import BytesIO
import json

@frappe.whitelist()
def moi_download_job_applicants_excel(job_title, base_fields, dynamic_questions):
    """
    Main Export Function.
    """
    # Parse JSON inputs
    if isinstance(base_fields, str):
        base_fields = json.loads(base_fields)
    if isinstance(dynamic_questions, str):
        dynamic_questions = json.loads(dynamic_questions)

    # 1. Fetch Job Applicants based on Filter
    filters = {}
    if job_title and job_title != "All":
        filters["job_title"] = job_title

    fields_to_fetch = ["name"] + base_fields
    
    applicants = frappe.get_all(
        "Job Applicant",
        filters=filters,
        fields=fields_to_fetch,
        order_by="creation desc"
    )

    if not applicants:
        frappe.throw("No applicants found for the selected criteria.")

    applicant_names = [d.name for d in applicants]

    # 2. Fetch Dynamic Answers (Child Table)
    child_data = frappe.get_all(
        "Job Dynamic Answer",
        filters={"parent": ["in", applicant_names]},
        fields=["parent", "question", "answer"]
    )

    # 3. Pivot Data: Map answers to applicants
    answers_map = {}
    for row in child_data:
        if row.parent not in answers_map:
            answers_map[row.parent] = {}
        answers_map[row.parent][row.question] = row.answer

    # 4. Prepare Excel Workbook
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Job Applicants"

    # --- Headers ---
    headers = []
    field_labels = {
        "applicant_name": "Applicant Name",
        "email_id": "Email",
        "phone_number": "Phone",
        "status": "Status",
        "job_title": "Job Title",
        "creation": "Created On",
        "modified": "Modified On"
    }
    
    for f in base_fields:
        headers.append(field_labels.get(f, f))
    
    headers.extend(dynamic_questions)

    # Write Headers to Row 1
    for col_num, header in enumerate(headers, 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_num, value=header)
        cell.font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)
        cell.fill = openpyxl.styles.PatternFill(start_color="DDDDDD", end_color="DDDDDD", fill_type="solid")

    # --- Data Rows ---
    for row_num, applicant in enumerate(applicants, 2):
        col_num = 1
        
        for field in base_fields:
            value = applicant.get(field, "")
            if hasattr(value, 'strftime'):
                value = value.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
            ws.cell(row=row_num, column=col_num, value=value)
            col_num += 1
        
        applicant_answers = answers_map.get(applicant.name, {})
        for question in dynamic_questions:
            answer = applicant_answers.get(question, "")
            ws.cell(row=row_num, column=col_num, value=answer)
            col_num += 1

    # Auto-adjust column widths
    for column in ws.columns:
        max_length = 0
        column_letter = column[0].column_letter
        for cell in column:
            try:
                if len(str(cell.value)) > max_length:
                    max_length = len(str(cell.value))
            except:
                pass
        adjusted_width = (max_length + 2)
        ws.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = min(adjusted_width, 50)

    # 5. Save and Return File
    file_name = f"Job_Applicants_{job_title or 'All'}.xlsx"
    
    output = BytesIO()
    wb.save(output)
    output.seek(0)
    
    frappe.response.filename = file_name
    frappe.response.filecontent = output.getvalue()
    frappe.response.type = "download"
    frappe.response.display_content_as = "attachment"

def update_attendance_on_checkin(doc):
    """
    When Employee Checkin is created on a day where employee is on leave,
    update the existing attendance record and delete duplicates.
    """
    
    employee = doc.employee
    checkin_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.time)
    
    # Check if there are attendance records for this date
    existing_attendances = frappe.get_all(
        "Attendance",
        filters={
            "employee": employee,
            "attendance_date": checkin_date,
            "docstatus": ["<", 2]  # Not cancelled
        },
        fields=["name", "status", "leave_type", "leave_application"]
    )
    
    if not existing_attendances:
        # No existing attendance, let system create one normally
        return
    
    # If there are multiple attendance records, merge them and delete duplicates
    if len(existing_attendances) > 1:
        # Find the leave-based attendance (prioritize this one)
        leave_attendance = None
        checkin_attendances = []
        
        for att in existing_attendances:
            if att.leave_type:
                leave_attendance = att
            else:
                checkin_attendances.append(att)
        
        if leave_attendance:
            attendance_to_keep = checkin_attendances
            attendances_to_delete = leave_attendance
        else:
            # If no leave attendance, keep the first one
            attendance_to_keep = existing_attendances[0]
            attendances_to_delete = existing_attendances[1:]
        
        # Delete duplicate attendance records
        for att in attendances_to_delete:
            try:
                frappe.delete_doc("Attendance", att.name, force=True)
                frappe.msgprint(f"Deleted duplicate attendance: {att.name}", alert=True)
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(f"Failed to delete attendance {att.name}: {str(e)}")
        
        # Work with the kept attendance record
        attendance = frappe.get_doc("Attendance", attendance_to_keep.name)
    else:
        # Only one attendance record exists
        attendance = frappe.get_doc("Attendance", existing_attendances[0].name)
    
    # Get all checkins for this employee on this date
    checkins = frappe.get_all(
        "Employee Checkin",
        filters={
            "employee": employee,
            "time": ["between", [
                frappe.utils.get_datetime(f"{checkin_date} 00:00:00"),
                frappe.utils.get_datetime(f"{checkin_date} 23:59:59")
            ]],
            "docstatus": 1
        },
        fields=["name", "time", "log_type"],
        order_by="time asc"
    )
    
    # Update attendance with checkin information
    if checkins:
        # Calculate working hours
        working_hours = calculate_working_hours(checkins)
        
        # Get first and last checkin times
        first_checkin = checkins[0].time if checkins else None
        last_checkout = checkins[-1].time if checkins else None
        
        # Update attendance with checkin information
        attendance.custom_working_hours = working_hours
        attendance.custom_checkin_count = len(checkins)
        attendance.custom_first_checkin = first_checkin
        attendance.custom_last_checkout = last_checkout
        attendance.custom_merged_record = 1
        
        # If attendance doesn't have leave_type but there's a leave application, update it
        if not attendance.leave_type:
            leave_app = frappe.db.exists(
                "Leave Application",
                {
                    "employee": employee,
                    "from_date": ["<=", checkin_date],
                    "to_date": [">=", checkin_date],
                    "docstatus": 1
                }
            )
            
            if leave_app:
                leave_doc = frappe.get_doc("Leave Application", leave_app)
                attendance.status = "On Leave"
                attendance.leave_type = leave_doc.leave_type
                attendance.leave_application = leave_doc.name
        
        attendance.save()
        frappe.db.commit()
        
        frappe.msgprint(
            f"Updated attendance record with working hours: {working_hours} hours",
            alert=True
        )

def calculate_working_hours(checkins):
    """Calculate total working hours from checkin/out records"""
    total_hours = 0
    check_in_time = None
    
    for checkin in checkins:
        if checkin.log_type == "IN":
            check_in_time = checkin.time
        elif checkin.log_type == "OUT" and check_in_time:
            hours = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_hours(checkin.time, check_in_time)
            total_hours += hours
            check_in_time = None
    
    return round(total_hours, 2)

source_name = frappe.form_dict.get('source_task')

def duplicate_task_tree(source_task_name, new_parent=None):
    # 1. جلب بيانات المهمة الأصلية
    old_task = frappe.get_doc("Task", source_task_name)
    new_task = frappe.new_doc("Task")
    
    # 2. نسخ كافة الحقول (بما فيها Is Group والحقول المخصصة)
    task_data = old_task.as_dict()
    excluded_fields = ["name", "owner", "creation", "modified", "modified_by", 
                       "depends_on", "lft", "rgt", "old_parent"]
    
    for key in task_data:
        if key not in excluded_fields:
            new_task.set(key, task_data[key])
            
    new_task.parent_task = new_parent
    new_task.status = "Open"
    
    # 3. الحفظ الأولي للمهمة
    new_task.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    current_new_name = new_task.name
    
    # 4. معالجة الأبناء (التعمق في الشجرة)
    children = frappe.get_all("Task", filters={"parent_task": source_task_name}, fields=["name", "subject"])
    
    created_subtasks = []
    for child in children:
        # استدعاء الدالة للأبناء وجلب أسمائهم الجديدة
        new_child_name = duplicate_task_tree(child.name, current_new_name)
        created_subtasks.append({
            "task": new_child_name,
            "subject": child.subject
        })
    
    # 5. تحديث جدول التبعيات (Dependencies) بدون تكرار وبطريقة ORM
    if created_subtasks:
        # نجلب نسخة طازجة لتجنب خطأ "Document Modified"
        doc = frappe.get_doc("Task", current_new_name)
        
        # التأكد من عدم إضافة المهمة إذا كانت موجودة مسبقاً (فحص يدوي بدلاً من SQL)
        existing_in_table = [d.task for d in doc.depends_on]
        
        for subtask in created_subtasks:
            if subtask["task"] not in existing_in_table:
                doc.append("depends_on", subtask)
                existing_in_table.append(subtask["task"])
        
        doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    
    return current_new_name

# تنفيذ العملية
if source_name:
    new_root_name = duplicate_task_tree(source_name)
    frappe.response['message'] = new_root_name

    txt = txt.replace("'", "")

    txt = txt.replace("(", "_")

def get_first_doc(doctype, filters):

        filters=filters,
        fields=["name"],
        limit=1
    )
    if rows and len(rows) > 0:

def map_relation_type(value):
    txt = str(value or "").strip()

    if txt == "Implements":
        return "Implements"

    if txt == "Supports":
        return "Supports"

    if txt == "Generates":
        return "Produces"

    if txt == "Validates":
        return "Supports"

    if txt == "Prints":
        return "Produces"

    if txt == "Enforces":
        return "Supports"

    if txt == "Executes":
        return "Supports"

    if txt == "Restricts":
        return "Supports"

    return "Related"


def map_coverage(value):
    txt = str(value or "").strip()

    if txt == "Covered":
        return "Full"

    if txt == "Partially Covered":
        return "Partial"

    if txt == "Needs Validation":
        return "Pending"

    if txt == "Not Covered":
        return "Not Covered"

    return "Pending"


def add_relation_if_missing(component_doc, relation_type, related_doctype, related_document, coverage_status, impact_level, notes):
    exists = False

    for rel in component_doc.relations:
        if rel.related_doctype == related_doctype and rel.related_document == related_document and rel.relation_type == relation_type:
            exists = True
            break

    if not exists:
        row = component_doc.append("relations", {})

        row.related_doctype = related_doctype
        row.related_document = related_document
        row.coverage_status = coverage_status
        row.impact_level = impact_level
        row.notes = notes

            block_name,
            "Full",
            "Medium",
            "Linked to Asset Management solution block."
        )

    comp.save(ignore_permissions=True)
    return comp.name

# Server Script Type: DocType Event
# Reference DocType: Media Production Test
# Event: After Save
#
# Handles every production_source other than Planned.
# Urgent routes to urgent_project; Requested/Ad-hoc/other routes to unplanned_project.
#
# Hierarchy:
# Project
# `-- Executing Department (Group)
#     `-- Unplanned/Urgent Group (Group)
#         `-- Material Type (Group)
#             `-- Production Item (real Task + assignment)
#
# RestrictedPython compatible: no imports, no helper functions, no +=, no clear_cache.

TASK_DT = "Task"
SETTINGS_DT = "Media Task Routing Settings"

created_tasks = []
updated_tasks = []
created_assignments = []
skipped = []

production_source = str(doc.get("production_source") or "").strip()

if production_source == "Planned":
    skipped.append("Production Source is Planned; this script handles non-planned production only.")
elif not production_source:
    skipped.append("Production Source is empty.")
elif not frappe.db.exists("DocType", SETTINGS_DT):
    frappe.throw("Media Task Routing Settings does not exist.")
else:
    settings_doc = frappe.get_doc(SETTINGS_DT)
    override_enabled = int(settings_doc.get("override_project_plan") or 0)

    if not override_enabled:
        frappe.throw("Override Project Plan is disabled in Media Task Routing Settings.")

    route_kind = "Unplanned"
    project = str(settings_doc.get("unplanned_project") or "").strip()
    source_group_name = str(settings_doc.get("unplanned_group_task_name") or "Unplanned Media Operations").strip()

    if production_source == "Urgent":
        route_kind = "Urgent"
        project = str(settings_doc.get("urgent_project") or "").strip()
        source_group_name = str(settings_doc.get("urgent_group_task_name") or "Urgent Media Operations").strip()

    if not project:
        frappe.throw(route_kind + " Project is not configured in Media Task Routing Settings.")
    if not frappe.db.exists("Project", project):
        frappe.throw("Configured Project does not exist: " + project)
    if not source_group_name:
        frappe.throw(route_kind + " Group Task Name is empty in Media Task Routing Settings.")

    # Exactly one Executing Department is required.
    executing_entities = []
    executing_seen = {}
    for relation in (doc.get("related_entities") or []):
        entity_role = str(relation.get("entity_role") or "").strip()
        entity_name = str(relation.get("entity") or "").strip()
        if entity_role == "Executing Department" and entity_name and entity_name not in executing_seen:
            executing_entities.append(entity_name)
            executing_seen[entity_name] = 1

    if len(executing_entities) == 0:
        frappe.throw("Media Production Test must contain one Executing Department in Related Entities.")
    if len(executing_entities) > 1:
        frappe.throw("Media Production Test must contain only one Executing Department.")

    executing_entity = executing_entities[0]

    task_meta = frappe.get_meta(TASK_DT)
    has_is_group = 1 if task_meta.has_field("is_group") else 0
    has_start_date = 1 if task_meta.has_field("exp_start_date") else 0
    has_end_date = 1 if task_meta.has_field("exp_end_date") else 0
    has_description = 1 if task_meta.has_field("description") else 0
    has_priority = 1 if task_meta.has_field("priority") else 0

    fallback_start = doc.get("request_date")
    fallback_end = doc.get("requested_completion_date")
    priority = "High" if route_kind == "Urgent" else "Medium"

    # Executing Department is always the top-level group under the Project.
    entity_task_name = ""
    entity_candidates = frappe.get_all(
        TASK_DT,
        filters={"project": project, "subject": executing_entity},
        fields=["name", "parent_task"],
        limit_page_length=100
    )
    for candidate in entity_candidates:
        if not str(candidate.get("parent_task") or "").strip():
            entity_task_name = candidate.get("name")
            break

    if not entity_task_name:
        if not int(settings_doc.get("create_missing_entity_group") or 0):
            frappe.throw("Executing Department group does not exist and automatic creation is disabled: " + executing_entity)

        entity_task_data = {
            "doctype": TASK_DT,
            "subject": executing_entity,
            "project": project,
            "status": "Open"
        }
        if has_is_group:
            entity_task_data["is_group"] = 1
        if fallback_start and has_start_date:
            entity_task_data["exp_start_date"] = fallback_start
        if fallback_end and has_end_date:
            entity_task_data["exp_end_date"] = fallback_end
        if has_description:
            entity_task_data["description"] = "Executing Department for non-planned media operations."
        entity_task_doc = frappe.get_doc(entity_task_data)
        entity_task_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        entity_task_name = entity_task_doc.name
        created_tasks.append(entity_task_name)

    # Unplanned/Urgent group under the Executing Department.
    source_group_task_name = frappe.db.exists(
        TASK_DT,
        {"project": project, "parent_task": entity_task_name, "subject": source_group_name}
    )
    if not source_group_task_name:
        source_group_data = {
            "doctype": TASK_DT,
            "subject": source_group_name,
            "project": project,
            "parent_task": entity_task_name,
            "status": "Open"
        }
        if has_is_group:
            source_group_data["is_group"] = 1
        if fallback_start and has_start_date:
            source_group_data["exp_start_date"] = fallback_start
        if fallback_end and has_end_date:
            source_group_data["exp_end_date"] = fallback_end
        if has_description:
            source_group_data["description"] = route_kind + " media operations group."
        source_group_doc = frappe.get_doc(source_group_data)
        source_group_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        source_group_task_name = source_group_doc.name
        created_tasks.append(source_group_task_name)

    started_items_count = 0

    for item in (doc.get("items") or []):
        item_status = str(item.get("item_status") or "").strip()
        if item_status != "Started":
            continue

        started_items_count = started_items_count + 1

        material_type = str(item.get("material_type") or "").strip()
        if not material_type:
            skipped.append("Started item row " + str(item.get("idx") or "") + " has no Material Type.")
            continue

        item_title = str(item.get("item_title") or "").strip()
        if not item_title:
            item_title = str(doc.get("request_title") or "Media Production Item").strip()
            item_title = item_title + " - " + material_type + " - " + str(item.get("idx") or "")

        item_start = item.get("start_date") or item.get("production_date") or fallback_start
        item_end = item.get("end_date") or fallback_end
        responsible = str(item.get("responsible") or "").strip()

        # Material Type group directly under the selected source group.
        material_group_name = frappe.db.exists(
            TASK_DT,
            {"project": project, "parent_task": source_group_task_name, "subject": material_type}
        )
        if not material_group_name:
            if not int(settings_doc.get("create_missing_category_group") or 0):
                skipped.append("Material Type group does not exist and automatic creation is disabled: " + material_type)
                continue

            material_group_data = {
                "doctype": TASK_DT,
                "subject": material_type,
                "project": project,
                "parent_task": source_group_task_name,
                "status": "Open"
            }
            if has_is_group:
                material_group_data["is_group"] = 1
            if item_start and has_start_date:
                material_group_data["exp_start_date"] = item_start
            if item_end and has_end_date:
                material_group_data["exp_end_date"] = item_end
            if has_description:
                material_group_data["description"] = route_kind + " Media Production material type."
            material_group_doc = frappe.get_doc(material_group_data)
            material_group_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            material_group_name = material_group_doc.name
            created_tasks.append(material_group_name)

        item_task_name = frappe.db.exists(
            TASK_DT,
            {"project": project, "parent_task": material_group_name, "subject": item_title}
        )

        task_description = "Generated from Media Production Test: " + str(doc.name)
        task_description = task_description + " | Source: " + production_source
        task_description = task_description + " | Item row: " + str(item.get("idx") or "")
        if item.get("notes"):
            task_description = task_description + "\n" + str(item.get("notes"))

        if item_task_name:
            item_task_doc = frappe.get_doc(TASK_DT, item_task_name)
            item_task_doc.project = project
            item_task_doc.parent_task = material_group_name
            item_task_doc.status = "Open"
            if has_is_group:
                item_task_doc.is_group = 0
            if item_start and has_start_date:
                item_task_doc.exp_start_date = item_start
            if item_end and has_end_date:
                item_task_doc.exp_end_date = item_end
            if has_priority:
                item_task_doc.priority = priority
            if has_description:
                item_task_doc.description = task_description
            item_task_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            updated_tasks.append(item_task_name)
        else:
            item_task_data = {
                "doctype": TASK_DT,
                "subject": item_title,
                "project": project,
                "parent_task": material_group_name,
                "status": "Open"
            }
            if has_is_group:
                item_task_data["is_group"] = 0
            if item_start and has_start_date:
                item_task_data["exp_start_date"] = item_start
            if item_end and has_end_date:
                item_task_data["exp_end_date"] = item_end
            if has_priority:
                item_task_data["priority"] = priority
            if has_description:
                item_task_data["description"] = task_description
            item_task_doc = frappe.get_doc(item_task_data)
            item_task_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            item_task_name = item_task_doc.name
            created_tasks.append(item_task_name)

        if item.get("name") and str(item.get("related_task") or "").strip() != item_task_name:
            frappe.db.set_value("Media Production Test Item", item.get("name"), "related_task", item_task_name, update_modified=False)

        # Assign only if no open assignment exists.
        open_assignments = frappe.get_all(
            "ToDo",
            filters={"reference_type": TASK_DT, "reference_name": item_task_name, "status": "Open"},
            fields=["name", "allocated_to"],
            limit_page_length=100
        )
        if len(open_assignments) == 0:
            if responsible:
                if not frappe.db.exists("User", responsible):
                    skipped.append("Responsible user does not exist: " + responsible)
                else:
                    assignment_doc = frappe.get_doc({
                        "doctype": "ToDo",
                        "allocated_to": responsible,
                        "reference_type": TASK_DT,
                        "reference_name": item_task_name,
                        "description": item_title,
                        "status": "Open",
                        "priority": priority
                    })
                    assignment_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                    created_assignments.append(assignment_doc.name)
            else:
                skipped.append("Started item has no Responsible user: " + item_title)

    if started_items_count == 0:
        skipped.append("No item with Item Status = Started.")

frappe.response["message"] = {
    "success": True,
    "media_production": doc.name,
    "production_source": production_source,
    "created_tasks_count": len(created_tasks),
    "updated_tasks_count": len(updated_tasks),
    "created_assignments_count": len(created_assignments),
    "created_tasks": created_tasks,
    "updated_tasks": updated_tasks,
    "created_assignments": created_assignments,
    "skipped": skipped
}

# ISO 9001 clause 7.4 communication matrix.

# IMS standards owned by the Directorate.

if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "IMS Standard"):
    standard_names = frappe.get_all(
        "IMS Standard",

                "requirements": clean_text(standard_doc.get("requirements")),

if frappe.db.exists("DocType", "IMS Work Instruction"):

# API: migrate_all_foreign_media_team_members
#
# الهدف:
# ترحيل بيانات Team Member 1 إلى Team Member 6
# من الحقول القديمة الثابتة إلى Child Table باسم team_members
# لجميع سجلات Foreign media.
#
# ملاحظات:
# - لا يحذف البيانات القديمة.
# - لا يعيد ترحيل السجل إذا كان الجدول يحتوي صفوفاً.
# - يستمر بالعمل حتى عند حدوث خطأ في سجل معين.
# - يتم تنفيذ Commit كل 20 سجل محفوظ.
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# الإعدادات الأساسية
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parent_doctype = "Foreign media"
child_doctype = "Foreign Media Team Member"
child_table_field = "team_members"
profession_doctype = "Professional position"

commit_batch_size = 20


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# التحقق من وجود DocType الأب
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if not frappe.db.exists("DocType", parent_doctype):
    frappe.throw(
        "DocType does not exist: " + parent_doctype
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# التحقق من وجود Child DocType
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if not frappe.db.exists("DocType", child_doctype):
    frappe.throw(
        "Child DocType does not exist: " + child_doctype
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# التحقق من وجود حقل Child Table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parent_meta = frappe.get_meta(parent_doctype)
table_field_meta = parent_meta.get_field(child_table_field)

if not table_field_meta:
    frappe.throw(
        "Child Table field does not exist: " + child_table_field
    )

if table_field_meta.fieldtype != "Table":
    frappe.throw(
        child_table_field + " is not a Table field."
    )

if table_field_meta.options != child_doctype:
    frappe.throw(
        "The Table field options must be: " + child_doctype
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# خرائط الحقول القديمة
# ------------------------------------------------------------

member_maps = [
    {
        "member_number": 1,
        "full_name": "name_team_member_1",
        "passport_photo": "pp",
        "profession": "profession1",
        "cv": "cv_team_member_1",
        "email_address": "email_team_member_1",
        "telephone_number": "phone_team_member_1"
    },
    {
        "member_number": 2,
        "full_name": "name_team_member_2",
        "passport_photo": "pp2",
        "profession": "profession2",
        "cv": "cv_team_member_2",
        "email_address": "email_team_member_2",
        "telephone_number": "phone_team_member_2"
    },
    {
        "member_number": 3,
        "full_name": "name_team_member_3",
        "passport_photo": "pp3",
        "profession": "profession3",
        "cv": "cv_team_member_3",
        "email_address": "email_team_member_3",
        "telephone_number": "phone_team_member_3"
    },
    {
        "member_number": 4,
        "full_name": "name_team_member_4",
        "passport_photo": "pp4",
        "profession": "profession4",
        "cv": "cv_team_member_4",
        "email_address": "email_team_member_4",
        "telephone_number": "phone_team_member_4"
    },
    {
        "member_number": 5,
        "full_name": "name_team_member_5",
        "passport_photo": "pp5",
        "profession": "profession5",
        "cv": "cv_team_member_5",
        "email_address": "email_team_member_5",
        "telephone_number": "phone_team_member_5"
    },
    {
        "member_number": 6,
        "full_name": "name_team_member_6",
        "passport_photo": "pp6",
        "profession": "profession6",
        "cv": "cv_team_member_6",
        "email_address": "email_team_member_6",
        "telephone_number": "phone_team_member_6"
    }
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# جلب جميع سجلات Foreign media
# ------------------------------------------------------------

records = frappe.get_all(
    parent_doctype,
    fields=["name"],
    order_by="creation asc"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# متغيرات الملخص العام
# ------------------------------------------------------------

total_records = len(records)

processed_records = 0
migrated_records_count = 0
migrated_members_count = 0

skipped_existing_table_count = 0
skipped_no_data_count = 0
failed_records_count = 0

commit_counter = 0

migrated_records = []
skipped_existing_table = []
skipped_no_data = []
failed_records = []
profession_warnings = []


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# المرور على جميع السجلات
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for record_item in records:

    record_name = record_item.get("name")
    processed_records = processed_records + 1

    try:

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # جلب السجل الحالي
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        doc = frappe.get_doc(
            parent_doctype,
            record_name
        )


        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # منع تكرار الترحيل
        #
        # إذا كان Child Table يحتوي صفاً واحداً على الأقل
        # يتم تجاوز السجل بالكامل.
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        existing_rows = doc.get(child_table_field) or []

        if len(existing_rows) > 0:

            skipped_existing_table_count = (
                skipped_existing_table_count + 1
            )

            skipped_existing_table.append({
                "record_name": record_name,
                "existing_child_rows": len(existing_rows),
                "reason": "Child table already contains rows."
            })

        else:

            # ------------------------------------------------
            # متغيرات خاصة بالسجل الحالي
            # ------------------------------------------------

            record_migrated_members = []
            record_migrated_count = 0


            # ------------------------------------------------
            # المرور على مجموعات الأعضاء الستة
            # ------------------------------------------------

            for member_map in member_maps:

                member_number = member_map.get("member_number")

                full_name_field = member_map.get("full_name")
                passport_photo_field = member_map.get(
                    "passport_photo"

                cv_field = member_map.get("cv")

                telephone_field = member_map.get(

                full_name_value = doc.get(full_name_field)
                passport_photo_value = doc.get(
                    passport_photo_field

                profession_value = doc.get(profession_field)
                cv_value = doc.get(cv_field)
                email_value = doc.get(email_field)
                telephone_value = doc.get(telephone_field)


                # --------------------------------------------
                # تنظيف القيم النصية
                # --------------------------------------------

                    full_name_value = str(
                        full_name_value

                if profession_value:
                    profession_value = str(
                        profession_value

                if email_value:
                    email_value = str(
                        email_value
                    ).strip()

                        telephone_value
                    ).strip()


                # --------------------------------------------
                # تحديد وجود بيانات للعضو
                # --------------------------------------------

                has_member_data = False

                if full_name_value:
                    has_member_data = True

                if passport_photo_value:
                    has_member_data = True

                if profession_value:
                    has_member_data = True

                if cv_value:
                    has_member_data = True

                if email_value:
                    has_member_data = True

                if telephone_value:
                    has_member_data = True


                # --------------------------------------------
                # إضافة العضو إلى Child Table
                # --------------------------------------------

                if has_member_data:

                    valid_profession_value = None

                    # ----------------------------------------
                    # التحقق من قيمة Profession
                    #
                    # لأن الحقل الجديد Link إلى
                    # Professional position
                    # ----------------------------------------

                    if profession_value:

                        profession_exists = frappe.db.exists(
                            profession_doctype,
                            profession_value
                        )

                        if profession_exists:
                            valid_profession_value = (
                                profession_value
                            )

                        else:
                            profession_warnings.append({
                                "record_name": record_name,
                                "member_number": member_number,
                                "legacy_value": profession_value,
                                "reason": (
                                    "Profession was not copied "
                                    "because it does not exist in "
                                    + profession_doctype
                                )
                            })


                    # ----------------------------------------
                    # إنشاء صف Child Table
                    # ----------------------------------------

                    child_row = doc.append(
                        child_table_field,
                        {}
                    )

                    child_row.full_name = full_name_value
                    child_row.passport_photo = (
                        passport_photo_value
                    )
                    child_row.profession = (
                        valid_profession_value
                    )
                    child_row.cv = cv_value
                    child_row.email_address = email_value
                    child_row.telephone_number = (
                        telephone_value
                    )


                    # ----------------------------------------
                    # تحديث إحصائيات السجل
                    # ----------------------------------------

                    record_migrated_count = (
                        record_migrated_count + 1
                    )

                    record_migrated_members.append({
                        "member_number": member_number,
                        "full_name": full_name_value,
                        "profession": valid_profession_value,
                        "email_address": email_value,
                        "telephone_number": telephone_value
                    })


            # ------------------------------------------------
            # حفظ السجل إذا تم ترحيل عضو واحد على الأقل
            # ------------------------------------------------

            if record_migrated_count > 0:

                doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
                doc.save()

                migrated_records_count = (
                    migrated_records_count + 1
                )

                migrated_members_count = (
                    migrated_members_count
                    + record_migrated_count
                )

                commit_counter = commit_counter + 1

                migrated_records.append({
                    "record_name": record_name,
                    "migrated_members_count": (
                        record_migrated_count
                    ),
                    "members": record_migrated_members
                })


                # --------------------------------------------
                # Commit كل عدد محدد من السجلات
                # --------------------------------------------

                if commit_counter >= commit_batch_size:

                    frappe.db.commit()
                    commit_counter = 0

            else:

                skipped_no_data_count = (
                    skipped_no_data_count + 1
                )

                skipped_no_data.append({
                    "record_name": record_name,
                    "reason": (
                        "All legacy team member fields are empty."
                    )
                })


    except Exception as error:

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # إلغاء تغييرات السجل الحالي غير المحفوظة
        # والاستمرار ببقية السجلات
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        frappe.db.rollback()

        commit_counter = 0

        failed_records_count = failed_records_count + 1

        error_message = str(error)

        failed_records.append({
            "record_name": record_name,
            "error": error_message
        })

        frappe.log_error(
            message=(
                "Foreign media team migration failed.\n"
                + "Record: "
                + str(record_name)
                + "\nError: "
                + error_message
            ),
            title="Foreign Media Team Migration Error"
        )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# تنفيذ Commit نهائي للسجلات المتبقية
# ------------------------------------------------------------

frappe.db.commit()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# إعادة النتيجة النهائية
# ------------------------------------------------------------

frappe.response["message"] = {

    "processed_records": processed_records,
    "migrated_records_count": migrated_records_count,
    "migrated_members_count": migrated_members_count,

    ),

    "failed_records_count": failed_records_count,
    "legacy_fields_preserved": True,
    "migrated_records": migrated_records,
    "skipped_existing_table": skipped_existing_table,
    "skipped_no_data": skipped_no_data,

    "failed_records": failed_records
}

# =========================================================================
# Server Script
# Script Type      : DocType Event
# Reference DocType: (الـ DocType المخصص الخاص بمحاضر الاجتماعات لديك)
# DocType Event    : After Save
# =========================================================================
# الهدف:
#   عند تحول حالة الـ Workflow إلى "Completed":
#   1) تجميع الموظفين من الجدول الفرعي attendees_table
#   2) جلب حسابات المستخدمين (user_id) من Employee
#   3) إسنادهم للمستند (ToDo + تحديث _assign تلقائياً + مشاركة الصلاحية)
#   4) إرسال Notification Log تظهر في الجرس تتضمن عنوان الاجتماع subject
# =========================================================================

# 1) تأكد أن حالة الـ Workflow هي "Completed"
if doc.get("workflow_state") == "Completed":

    # (اختياري لكن مستحسن) نفّذ فقط عند لحظة التحول الفعلي إلى Completed
    # لمنع تكرار الإسناد والإشعارات عند كل عملية حفظ لاحقة للمستند
    state_just_completed = doc.has_value_changed("workflow_state")

    if state_just_completed:

        # 2) تجميع الموظفين من الجدول الفرعي attendees_table
        employee_ids = []
        for row in (doc.get("attendees_table") or []):
            emp = row.get("employee")
            if emp and emp not in employee_ids:
                employee_ids.append(emp)

        # استخراج user_id لكل موظف عبر frappe.db.get_value (مسموح بالكامل)
        user_ids = []
        for emp in employee_ids:
            user_id = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", emp, "user_id")
            if user_id and user_id not in user_ids:
                user_ids.append(user_id)

        meeting_subject = doc.get("subject") or doc.name

        # 3) و 4) الإسناد + المشاركة + الإشعار لكل مستخدم
        for user in user_ids:

            # تجنّب تكرار إنشاء ToDo لنفس المستخدم إن كان مسنداً له مسبقاً
            already_assigned = frappe.db.exists("ToDo", {
                "reference_type": doc.doctype,
                "reference_name": doc.name,
                "allocated_to": user,
                "status": "Open"
            })

            if not already_assigned:

                # --- إنشاء ToDo ---
                # إنشاء سجل ToDo مباشرة يقوم تلقائياً (عبر ToDo.on_update)
                # بتحديث حقل _assign في المستند دون الحاجة للمس الحقل يدوياً
                todo = frappe.get_doc({
                    "doctype": "ToDo",
                    "allocated_to": user,

        frappe.throw("القيمة المدخلة أطول من الحد المسموح.")

def fail(message, status=400):

if frappe.request.method != "POST":

    p = frappe.form_dict or {}
    anonymous = 1 if str(p.get("anonymous") or "0") in ["1", "true", "True"] else 0
    privacy = 1 if str(p.get("privacy_consent") or "0") in ["1", "true", "True"] else 0

    if not anonymous:
        if not complainant_name:

        if not mobile and not email:
            frappe.throw("يرجى إدخال رقم هاتف أو بريد إلكتروني.")
    if email and ("@" not in email or "." not in email.split("@")[-1]):
        frappe.throw("صيغة البريد الإلكتروني غير صحيحة.")
    if mobile:
        for ch in mobile:

    category_filters = {"name": category}
    category_meta = frappe.get_meta("Complaint Category")

        frappe.throw("تصنيف الشكوى غير متاح.")

    # A conservative global Guest creation limit. This uses existing records
    # and requires no unsupported cache API or additional DocType.
    minute_ago = frappe.utils.add_to_date(
        frappe.utils.now_datetime(), minutes=-1
    )
    recent_count = frappe.db.count("Complaint", {
        "source": "Public Portal",
        "creation": [">=", minute_ago]
    })
    if recent_count >= 20:
        frappe.throw("عدد الطلبات كبير حالياً. يرجى المحاولة بعد قليل.")

    random_row = frappe.db.sql(
        "select upper(substr(replace(uuid(),'-',''),1,8)), "
        "upper(substr(replace(uuid(),'-',''),1,12))"
    )[0]
    year_value = str(frappe.utils.today())[0:4]

    while frappe.db.exists("Complaint", {"public_reference": public_reference}):

            "attached_to_name": complaint.name,
            "attached_to_field": "attachment",
            "content": file_content,
            "decode": 1
        })
        file_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.set_value("Complaint", complaint.name, "attachment", file_doc.file_url)

    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "success": True,
